job.organization: South Orange County Community College District

items.item_text: 01. Describe how you have applied Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Accessibility (DEIA) principles in your professional work. Please provide one or two brief examples of how you have contributed to an inclusive and equitable environment, particularly for individuals from historically underrepresented or marginalized groups.

02. Do you have experience developing or implementing sustainability initiatives, energy management programs, or environmental compliance plans within a facilities operations setting? Options: Yes | No

03. Do you have experience leading or contributing to large-scale capital construction or facilities master planning projects (e.g., new buildings, major renovations, five-year construction plans)? Options: Yes | No
04. Do you have experience leading emergency preparedness, disaster response planning, or campus safety programs? Options: Yes | No
05. Have you managed an annual facilities operations budget? If so, what is (or was) the size of the budget (e.g., $1 million, etc.)?

06. Have you aligned facilities planning with broader institutional priorities (such as enrollment strategy, sustainability goals, or student/employee needs), including engaging stakeholders across departments or outside agencies? If so, please provide an example.
